Use only newly labelled containers/internal network. Never stop/restart existing demo SQL or other containers, Docker or apps; no new packages/downloads. If RAM is insufficient, stop before loading and report BLOCKED.

At the first case failure, RAM/time/lease/service change or demo expiry/stop, stop/remove only owned evaluation containers/network. Preserve failure/raw replies privately; unexecuted cases stay UNRUN. No automatic retries, model substitution or prompt/guard relaxation.

Owner preview is conditional on complete automated success and ends at one hour or demo expiry, whichever comes first. Core shutdown returns AI to Unavailable; preserve SQL/accounts/Manual access and verify them afterward.
